notes: This contract pins the private 2025 FOM source boundary used before federation creation. A missing designator remains source_not_found, while an existing path that cannot be consumed as a regular XML source is source_unreadable and maps through the embedded federation-management boundary to ErrorReadingFOM. The Requirements Lab candidate covers rejection of an unloadable FOM module but does not provide a row-level filesystem diagnostic relation; this is source/test traceability only, not a public service catalog, JUnit evidence record, or conformance claim.
